patch_description:
Combines the current program’s modular structure with the inspiration program’s candidate ordering and sparse route selection. Route features are precomputed with NumPy to reduce repeated work.

A selective overlap correction, applied only to the strongest demands, discourages rewarding both a direct link and redundant alternatives. This borrows the median-quality improvement of the overlap variant without tripling every route’s couplings. Direct-link rewards and the degree-penalty weight remain unchanged. Performance gains require evaluation.
